packet.userIntent: Why does the lobby page fail to resolve room IDs?
packet.finalAssistantSummary: Room IDs only exist after the first client joins.

evidence.excerpt: getRoomId('lobby') throws ROOM_NOT_FOUND even though the lobby is configured.

attempt 1: getRoomId -> ROOM_NOT_FOUND
attempt 2 after client.join(): getRoomId -> 'rm_123'
Confirmed: Colyseus room IDs are unavailable until the first client joins; cache the ID after join instead of at startup.

claims.text: Colyseus room IDs are unavailable until the first client joins; resolve them after join, not at startup.

proposedEntry.title: Colyseus room IDs need a joined client
proposedEntry.summary: getRoomId fails with ROOM_NOT_FOUND until the first client joins.
proposedEntry.body: Colyseus only materializes room IDs after the first client joins. Resolve IDs after `client.join()` succeeds; resolving at startup throws ROOM_NOT_FOUND.

expect.notes: Non-obvious behavioral trap verified after two failed attempts; guide positive example.
